Author: DhogGPT
Name: Deep Ducking
Punchline: Deep Ducking public host and authenticated module access.
Description:
The Deep Ducking public host provides the introduction, community links and authenticated loading of separately supplied DDuck modules. /dd and /dduck open the introduction when no module is loaded.

Full module required for all commands below except opening the host window.

Commands (all /dd commands also accept /dduck):
/dd [toggle main window]
/dduck [alias for /dd; accepts all commands below]
/dd mini [toggle Mini]
/dd settings [open Settings]
/dd config [open Settings]
/dd debug [open Advanced]
/dd help [open command help]
/dd start [floor] [start or continue selected save; optional fresh-run floor]
/dd party-start [floor] [alias for start]
/dd party [select fixed-party POTD while idle]
/dd adopt [bind eligible already-entered party dungeon]
/dd hold [pause local output; retain run for Resume]
/dd resume [resume retained local run after readiness checks]
/dd nextstop [exit after next boss]
/dd ns [exit after next boss]
/dd stop [FULL STOP; persist local lock across reloads; stay in duty]
/dd reset-stop [clear eligible FULL STOP after cleanup; do not start]
/dd status [print local status]
/dd inspect [record read-only client and native observations]
/dd saves [open Saves]
/dd saves info <dungeon> [inspect native saves]
/dd saves delete <dungeon> <1|2> [delete selected save after native checks; no extra confirmation]
/dd saves dof <dungeon> <1|2> <on|off> [set future-failure deletion preference; no deletion now]
/dd saves cancel [cancel pending save or Start preparation; completed actions remain]

Dungeon arguments: potd, hoh, eo, pt. [floor] is optional; <...> is required. Choose one value for 1|2 or on|off; omit brackets when typing. Start can replace stopped state; Resume can release an eligible retained in-dungeon run. nextstop and ns retain the save and keep Mini open until return is observed; repeat to confirm the same request. Use the existing boss-break button to cancel.
